mathematical_memory: Strict-N3 STAR two-channel plus a leaf eigenvalue does not imply a uniform rank-three physical cross-volume. The explicit three-ray family has spectrum {1,1,-1}; a hub carries e2 mass 1-epsilon, residual e2 mass epsilon, while e1/e3 are diffuse. Every disjoint cross block has singular values sqrt(aI aJ), sqrt(bI cJ), sqrt(cI bJ), hence Pi3<=sqrt(epsilon)/4. Yet the exact grouped original-product law is Q=Y1^2+2Y2Y3 and has density <=4sqrt(2)e. Future closure must detect/group the third source rather than force a D/D' rank-three cut.
